steps.method: ECUT=25 keV fixed, same rebuilt experimental material table and source seeds; steps 0.2/0.05/0.0125 are existing diagnostic instruments. Single slit 32M/case, thick multi-slit 16M/configuration. ±1 SEM after batch ROI integration; FWHM bootstrap SD. Step changes affect all materials and physics, not a boundary-only intervention.

surface_16M.method: 16 independent 1M-history chunks per step/case; same seeds and transport data. Passive first/second electron-segment interpolation at z=-1 and 0 cm; photon energy constant during each flight. Rows include repeated forward/reverse crossings, not independent particles. Marginal spectra cannot be replayed. Total counts are statistical-weighted currents through a finite 16.01x16 cm plane, not 1/cos fluence. Charged energies are kinetic only. Dose arrays agree bit-for-bit with uninstrumented transport for every batch.

surface_64M.method: 64M per step, slit only, same paired batch seeds; 25 keV cutoff fixed; passive surface scorer. All 64 default batches and first 32 finest batches are dose-bit-identical to uninstrumented runs. Crossing counts include repeated crossings; energies for charged particles are kinetic. Central band |x|<0.25 mm, full y. SEM after within-batch region integration.

passive_instrument.description: Passive local surface scorer; original transport source snapshot; second-half energy linearly interpolated, not a Geant4 transport reconstruction. Counts include repeated crossings and are not a replay source.

region_restricted.method: 32M/case and matched seeds. All instruments use ECUT=25 keV. Fine step=0.0125; other region=0.2. Region chosen by step-start material (non-water brass/air vs water), not by a test that identifies actual boundary-crossing steps. No production library edits. ±SEM for paired dose changes; paired bootstrap SD for FWHM changes.
